definition: A program on a phone or a tablet.
examples: I downloaded a new app.
This app helps me learn Portuguese.
There's an app for everything now.

spanish.definition: Programa en un teléfono o una tableta.

definition: A short word for advertisement.
examples: I saw an ad for a cheap flight.
The ad was on TV last night.
She put an ad in the newspaper.

spanish.definition: Palabra corta para anuncio publicitario.

definition: A wooden stick used in baseball; a flying animal that is active at night.
examples: He hit the ball with the bat.
Bats sleep during the day.
A bat flew out of the cave.

spanish.definition: Palo de madera usado en béisbol; animal volador activo de noche.

definition: A part of the sea with land curving around it.
examples: We sailed across the bay.
San Francisco Bay is very beautiful.
The hotel has a view of the bay.

spanish.definition: Parte del mar con tierra curva alrededor.

definition: A taxi.
examples: Let's take a cab to the airport.
I called a cab.
The cab driver knew the way.

spanish.definition: Carro que te lleva por dinero.

definition: A soft hat with a curved front part; a small cover for a bottle.
examples: He wore a baseball cap.
Put the cap back on the bottle.
She lost her blue cap.

spanish.definition: Sombrero suave con visera; tapa pequeña de una botella.

definition: The act of looking after someone; to feel that something is important.
examples: The baby needs a lot of care.
I really care about you.
She took good care of her mother.

spanish.definition: Acto de cuidar a alguien; sentir que algo es importante.

definition: A small insect; a problem in a computer program.
examples: There's a bug on your shirt.
The app has a bug.
I think I caught a stomach bug.

spanish.definition: Insecto pequeño; problema en un programa de computadora.

definition: A large container for trash or for storing things.
examples: Put the bottles in the recycling bin.
The rice is in a big plastic bin.
Throw that paper in the bin.

spanish.definition: Recipiente grande para basura o para guardar cosas.

definition: To bend your body forward to show respect.
examples: The actors bowed at the end of the play.
He bowed to the queen.
She took a bow after her song.

spanish.definition: Doblar el cuerpo hacia adelante para mostrar respeto.

definition: A small part of a plant that becomes a flower or a leaf.
examples: The trees have new buds in spring.
A rose bud opened this morning.
The cold killed the flower buds.

spanish.definition: Parte pequeña de una planta que se vuelve flor u hoja.

definition: A wall built across a river to hold back water.
examples: They built a dam on the river.
The Hoover Dam is in Nevada.
The dam produces electricity.

spanish.definition: Muro construido en un río para contener el agua.

definition: A small round mark.
examples: She wore a dress with white dots.
Put a dot over the letter i.
The plane looked like a dot in the sky.

spanish.definition: Marca pequeña y redonda.

definition: Money you pay for a service.
examples: There's a small fee for parking.
The bank charges a monthly fee.
College fees are very high.

spanish.definition: Dinero que pagas por un servicio.

definition: A common illness like a very bad cold.
examples: I stayed in bed with the flu.
Did you get your flu shot?
Half the class has the flu.

spanish.definition: Enfermedad común parecida a un resfriado muy fuerte.

definition: A thick cloud near the ground.
examples: The fog was very thick this morning.
I couldn't see the road in the fog.
The bridge disappeared into the fog.

spanish.definition: Nube espesa cerca del suelo.

definition: A wild animal like a small dog with a long, thick tail.
examples: A fox ran across the road.
The fox stole a chicken.
We saw a red fox in the woods.

spanish.definition: Animal salvaje parecido a un perro pequeño con cola larga y gruesa.

definition: The soft, thick hair of an animal.
examples: The cat has soft black fur.
She wore a fur coat.
There's dog fur all over the sofa.

spanish.definition: Pelo suave y espeso de un animal.

definition: An empty space between two things.
examples: There's a gap in the fence.
He has a gap between his front teeth.
The gap between rich and poor is growing.

spanish.definition: Espacio vacío entre dos cosas.

definition: A place to exercise.
examples: I go to the gym three times a week.
The kids play basketball in the gym.
She joined a new gym.

spanish.definition: Lugar para hacer ejercicio.

definition: Salty meat from a pig.
examples: I'd like a ham and cheese sandwich.
We have ham at Easter.
She cut a slice of ham.

spanish.definition: Carne salada de cerdo.

definition: Dry grass used to feed animals.
examples: The horses are eating hay.
The kids jumped in the hay.
We stored the hay in the barn.

spanish.definition: Hierba seca para alimentar a los animales.

definition: An adult female chicken.
examples: The hen laid an egg.
We keep ten hens in the yard.
The hen sat on her eggs.

spanish.definition: Pollo hembra adulto.

definition: A plant used to add flavor to food.
examples: She grows herbs in the kitchen.
Add some fresh herbs to the soup.
Basil is my favorite herb.

spanish.definition: Planta usada para dar sabor a la comida.

definition: The part of your body at the top of your leg.
examples: She fell and broke her hip.
He stood with his hands on his hips.
My grandmother needs a new hip.

spanish.definition: Parte del cuerpo arriba de la pierna.

definition: A small, simple house.
examples: They live in a small hut.
We slept in a hut in the mountains.
The hut has a grass roof.

spanish.definition: Casa pequeña y simple.

definition: The colored liquid in a pen or a printer.
examples: The printer is out of ink.
Please sign in blue ink.
There's ink on your shirt.

spanish.definition: Líquido de color de un bolígrafo o una impresora.

definition: A glass container with a lid.
examples: I can't open this jar.
She keeps cookies in a jar.
We bought a jar of peanut butter.

spanish.definition: Recipiente de vidrio con tapa.

definition: A fast plane.
examples: The president flew in a private jet.
A jet flew over the house.
I always get jet lag after long flights.

spanish.definition: Avión rápido.

definition: Great happiness.
examples: She cried with joy.
The baby brought us so much joy.
It's a joy to watch you dance.

spanish.definition: Gran felicidad.

definition: A set of tools or things for a purpose.
examples: We keep a first aid kit in the car.
He bought a tool kit.
She built the model from a kit.

spanish.definition: Conjunto de herramientas o cosas para un fin.

definition: A short word for laboratory.
examples: We have science lab on Fridays.
The blood test went to the lab.
She works in a research lab.

spanish.definition: Palabra corta para laboratorio.

definition: The top of your legs when you sit; one trip around a track.
examples: The cat slept on my lap.
She held the baby on her lap.
He ran four laps around the field.

spanish.definition: Parte de arriba de las piernas al sentarse; una vuelta a una pista.

definition: A curved piece of glass in glasses or a camera.
examples: I wear contact lenses.
The camera has a good lens.
One lens of my glasses is broken.

spanish.definition: Pedazo curvo de vidrio en gafas o cámaras.

definition: The top that covers a container.
examples: Put the lid on the pot.
I can't get the lid off.
The trash can has a green lid.

spanish.definition: Parte que cubre un recipiente.

definition: A thick piece of a tree; a written record.
examples: He put another log on the fire.
We sat on a log by the river.
The ship's captain keeps a daily log.

spanish.definition: Pedazo grueso de un árbol; registro escrito.

definition: A tool for washing floors; to wash a floor with this tool.
examples: Get the mop and clean this up.
She mopped the kitchen floor.
He's mopping the hallway.

spanish.definition: Herramienta para lavar pisos; lavar un piso con ella.

definition: Wet, soft earth.
examples: The kids came home covered in mud.
Our car got stuck in the mud.
There's mud on your boots.

spanish.definition: Tierra mojada y blanda.

definition: A large cup with a handle.
examples: He drank coffee from a big mug.
She gave me a mug for my birthday.
Wash your mug when you finish.

spanish.definition: Taza grande con asa.

definition: Material with holes, used to catch fish or in sports.
examples: The ball hit the net.
The fishermen pulled in their nets.
Basketball hoops have a net.

spanish.definition: Material con huecos usado para pescar o en deportes.

definition: A hard fruit from a tree; a small piece of metal used with a bolt.
examples: I'm allergic to nuts.
Squirrels bury nuts in the ground.
Tighten the nut with a wrench.

spanish.definition: Fruto duro de un árbol; pieza pequeña de metal que se usa con un perno.

definition: A large tree with very hard wood.
examples: There's an old oak in the yard.
The table is made of oak.
Oak trees can live for hundreds of years.

spanish.definition: Árbol grande de madera muy dura.

definition: A bird with big eyes that hunts at night.
examples: I heard an owl last night.
Owls can turn their heads very far.
An owl sat on the branch.

spanish.definition: Ave de ojos grandes que caza de noche.

definition: A metal container for cooking on a stove.
examples: Heat some oil in a pan.
Wash the pan after you cook.
She fried the eggs in a small pan.

spanish.definition: Recipiente de metal para cocinar en la estufa.

definition: The foot of a dog, a cat, or a bear.
examples: The dog hurt its paw.
The cat licked its paw.
We saw bear paw prints in the snow.

spanish.definition: Pie de un perro, un gato o un oso.

definition: A tool for writing with ink.
examples: Can I borrow your pen?
Sign here with a black pen.
My pen ran out of ink.

spanish.definition: Instrumento para escribir con tinta.

definition: A short, sharp piece of metal; a secret number; to attach with a pin.
examples: She pinned a flower to her dress.
Enter your PIN at the machine.
I stepped on a pin.

spanish.definition: Pieza corta y afilada de metal; número secreto; sujetar con alfiler.

definition: A deep hole in the ground; the hard seed of some fruits.
examples: They dug a deep pit.
Don't eat the peach pit.
We cooked the meat in a fire pit.

spanish.definition: Hueco profundo en el suelo; semilla dura de algunas frutas.

definition: A deep round container for cooking; a container for a plant.
examples: Boil the water in a large pot.
I made a pot of coffee.
She put the plant in a new pot.

spanish.definition: Recipiente hondo y redondo para cocinar; recipiente para una planta.

definition: An old piece of cloth used for cleaning.
examples: He wiped the table with a rag.
Use an old rag to clean the car.
The beggar was dressed in rags.

spanish.definition: Pedazo viejo de tela para limpiar.

definition: A narrow line of light.
examples: A ray of sunlight came through the window.
The sun's rays can burn your skin.
There's a ray of hope.

spanish.definition: Línea estrecha de luz.

definition: One of the curved bones in your chest; meat from this part of an animal.
examples: He broke two ribs in the accident.
We ordered barbecue ribs.
My ribs hurt when I cough.

spanish.definition: Uno de los huesos curvos del pecho; carne de esta parte de un animal.

definition: A long, thin stick.
examples: He bought a new fishing rod.
The curtain rod fell down.
They used a metal rod to fix the fence.

spanish.definition: Palo largo y delgado.

definition: A line of people or things.
examples: We sat in the front row.
There's a row of trees along the street.
We won three games in a row.

spanish.definition: Línea de personas o cosas.

definition: A small carpet.
examples: There's a red rug in the living room.
The dog sleeps on the rug.
She shook the rug outside.

spanish.definition: Alfombra pequeña.

definition: An amount of money; the total when you add numbers.
examples: He paid a large sum of money.
The sum of two and three is five.
She left a small sum for the kids.

spanish.definition: Cantidad de dinero; total al sumar números.

definition: A small label; a children's chasing game.
examples: Check the price tag.
The kids are playing tag.
Cut the tag off your new shirt.

spanish.definition: Marca pequeña; juego infantil de perseguir.

definition: To touch something lightly; a device that controls water.
examples: He tapped me on the shoulder.
Tap the screen to open it.
We drink tap water at home.

spanish.definition: Tocar algo suavemente; aparato que controla el agua.

definition: A soft silver metal; a small metal container.
examples: The roof is made of tin.
She keeps cookies in an old tin.
We bought a tin of mints.

spanish.definition: Metal blando y plateado; recipiente pequeño de metal.

definition: A large car for carrying people or things.
examples: We rented a van for the move.
A white van stopped outside.
The band travels in an old van.

spanish.definition: Carro grande para llevar personas o cosas.

definition: A word that shows an action, like run or eat.
examples: The word run is a verb.
English has many irregular verbs.
Find the verb in this sentence.

spanish.definition: Palabra que muestra una acción, como correr o comer.

definition: The thin net a spider makes; the internet.
examples: A spider made a web in the corner.
I searched the web for a cheap hotel.
She designs pages for the web.

spanish.definition: Malla delgada que hace una araña; el internet.

definition: A wild plant growing where you don't want it.
examples: The garden is full of weeds.
I spent the morning pulling weeds.
Weeds grow fast after the rain.

spanish.definition: Planta silvestre que crece donde no la quieres.

definition: A place where people can see wild animals.
examples: We took the kids to the zoo.
The zoo has two new pandas.
I love the monkeys at the zoo.

spanish.definition: Lugar donde la gente puede ver animales salvajes.

definition: A very small insect that lives in large groups.
examples: There are ants in the kitchen.
An ant can carry heavy things.
The ants found the sugar.

spanish.definition: Insecto muy pequeño que vive en grupos grandes.

definition: A yellow and black flying insect that makes honey.
examples: A bee stung me on the arm.
Bees make honey.
There's a bee on that flower.

spanish.definition: Insecto volador amarillo y negro que hace miel.

definition: A tool with sharp teeth for cutting wood; to cut with this tool.
examples: He cut the board with a saw.
She sawed the branch off the tree.
Be careful with that saw.

spanish.definition: Herramienta con dientes afilados para cortar madera; cortar con ella.

definition: A sweet food made from fruit; a line of cars that can't move.
examples: I put strawberry jam on my toast.
We were stuck in a traffic jam.
She makes her own jam.

spanish.definition: Comida dulce hecha de fruta; fila de carros que no se pueden mover.

definition: A very small unit of weight.
examples: This letter weighs twenty grams.
Add 100 grams of sugar.
There are a thousand grams in a kilo.

spanish.definition: Unidad muy pequeña de peso.

definition: A long period of time in history.
examples: It was the end of an era.
We live in the digital era.
The building is from the Victorian era.

spanish.definition: Largo período de la historia.

definition: To move your hand or an object over something, pressing on it.
examples: She rubbed her eyes.
He rubbed some cream on his arm.
Stop rubbing your nose.

spanish.definition: Mover la mano o un objeto sobre algo, presionando.

definition: To move your head up and down to say yes.
examples: He nodded and smiled.
She nodded in agreement.
He gave me a little nod.

spanish.definition: Mover la cabeza de arriba abajo para decir que sí.

definition: To put something quickly into a liquid; a thick sauce for snacks.
examples: She dipped her toe in the water.
He dipped the bread in the soup.
We had chips and dip.

spanish.definition: Meter algo rápido en un líquido; salsa espesa para pasabocas.

definition: To tear something quickly.
examples: I ripped my jeans on the fence.
He ripped the letter in half.
She's ripping up old photos.

spanish.definition: Romper algo rápido.

definition: To ask a court to make someone pay you money.
examples: He sued the company.
She's suing her doctor.
They threatened to sue us.

spanish.definition: Pedirle a un juez que obligue a alguien a pagarte dinero.

definition: To cook food in hot oil.
examples: She fried two eggs.
I'm frying some onions.
Fry the fish for five minutes.

spanish.definition: Cocinar comida en aceite caliente.

definition: To change the color of hair or cloth; a substance that does this.
examples: She dyed her hair red.
He's dyeing his shirt black.
This hair dye washes out.

spanish.definition: Cambiar el color del pelo o de la tela; sustancia que lo hace.

definition: To say officially that something isn't allowed.
examples: The city banned plastic bags.
Smoking is banned in restaurants.
There's a ban on phones in class.

spanish.definition: Decir oficialmente que algo no está permitido.

definition: An offer of money, especially at a sale.
examples: He made a bid on the house.
She bid $200 for the painting.
They're bidding on a new contract.

spanish.definition: Oferta de dinero, sobre todo en una venta.

definition: To close something with a zipper.
examples: Zip up your jacket; it's cold.
She zipped her bag.
He's zipping up the tent.

spanish.definition: Cerrar algo con una cremallera.

definition: Not bright.
examples: The light in the room was dim.
It's too dim to read here.
We ate in a dim little restaurant.

spanish.definition: Que no es brillante.

definition: Sick.
examples: She's seriously ill.
He felt ill after dinner.
My father has been ill for a month.

spanish.definition: Que no está sano.

definition: Covered with ice; very cold.
examples: The roads are icy this morning.
She had an icy drink.
An icy wind came from the north.

spanish.definition: Cubierto de hielo; muy frío.

definition: Short pants.
examples: It's hot, so I'm wearing shorts.
He bought new running shorts.
Kids wear shorts in the summer.

spanish.definition: Pantalones cortos.

definition: Two lenses in a frame that help you see.
examples: I can't read without my glasses.
She wears glasses.
Where did I leave my glasses?

spanish.definition: Dos lentes en un marco que te ayudan a ver.

definition: A warm piece of clothing for the top of your body.
examples: Put on a sweater; it's cold.
My mom knit me a sweater.
He wore a gray wool sweater.

spanish.definition: Prenda cálida para la parte de arriba del cuerpo.

definition: A soft sports shoe.
examples: I bought new sneakers.
He wears white sneakers to work.
One of my sneakers has a hole.

spanish.definition: Zapato suave para hacer deporte.

definition: An open shoe for warm weather.
examples: She wore sandals to the beach.
I broke a sandal strap.
These leather sandals are comfortable.

spanish.definition: Zapato abierto para clima cálido.

definition: A soft shoe you wear at home.
examples: He came to the door in his slippers.
Where are my slippers?
She got fuzzy slippers for Christmas.

spanish.definition: Zapato suave que usas en casa.

definition: Clothes you wear to bed.
examples: The kids are already in their pajamas.
I stayed in my pajamas all day.
She wore blue pajamas.

spanish.definition: Ropa que usas para dormir.

definition: A piece of jewelry for your ear.
examples: She lost one of her earrings.
He wears a small gold earring.
I bought silver earrings for my mom.

spanish.definition: Joya para la oreja.

definition: Dark glasses that protect your eyes from the sun.
examples: Don't forget your sunglasses.
He always wears sunglasses.
I left my sunglasses on the beach.

spanish.definition: Gafas oscuras que protegen los ojos del sol.

definition: A device you wear on your ears to listen to music.
examples: He studies with his headphones on.
I bought wireless headphones.
Use your headphones, please.

spanish.definition: Aparato que te pones en las orejas para escuchar música.

definition: A device that gives power to a phone.
examples: I forgot my phone charger.
Can I borrow your charger?
This charger doesn't work.

spanish.definition: Aparato que le da energía a un teléfono.

definition: A machine that puts words and pictures on paper.
examples: The printer is out of paper.
We bought a new color printer.
Send the file to the printer.

spanish.definition: Máquina que pone palabras e imágenes en papel.

definition: A person who gives a talk; a device that plays sound.
examples: She's a great public speaker.
The speakers are too loud.
He's a native speaker of English.

spanish.definition: Persona que da una charla; aparato que reproduce sonido.

definition: A large picture on a wall.
examples: He has a movie poster in his room.
She put up posters for the concert.
The walls are covered with posters.

spanish.definition: Imagen grande en una pared.

definition: A small picture with glue on the back.
examples: The teacher gave me a gold sticker.
My laptop is covered in stickers.
She put a sticker on the box.

spanish.definition: Imagen pequeña con pegante por detrás.

definition: A person between thirteen and nineteen years old.
examples: They have two teenagers at home.
I met him when I was a teenager.
Teenagers need more sleep.

spanish.definition: Persona de trece a diecinueve años.

definition: A person who owns or works on a farm.
examples: The farmer grows corn and beans.
My grandfather was a farmer.
We buy eggs from a local farmer.

spanish.definition: Persona dueña de una finca o que trabaja en ella.
